description: Any app's store record in one storefront: name, rating and rating count, version, price, distribution, badge and in-app purchase count, with the day of the record. For App Store apps, `listingExtras` adds the languages the app supports, its star breakdown (1★ to 5★), live and upcoming in-app events, the promotional text and the featured in-app purchases, with its own `measuredAt`; it is null when not measured. Takes an App Store id or a Google Play package name.

appId.description: App Store id (e.g. 570060128) or Google Play package name

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (defaults to us)

name: hive_app_details
